info.title: IELTS Practice API
info.description: Speaking + Writing practice API. Auth: Better Auth at /api/auth/* (cookie for web, `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for iOS — token returned in the `set-auth-token` header on sign-in).

isAnonymous.description: A guest (anonymous session, no account yet): show "Create an account", hide keys, history and review

gptLiveAvailable.description: This user has an OpenAI key (or is the owner)

realtimeAvailable.description: Deprecated alias of gptLiveAvailable (app versions from before GPT-Live)

geminiLiveAvailable.description: This user has a Gemini key (or is the owner)

liveProviders.description: Live examiner providers this user may use (their own keys; the owner may use the server keys)

resetAt.description: ISO instant the window resets; show in local time. null when unlimited

window.description: day: resets 00:00 UTC; week: resets Monday 00:00 UTC

blocked.description: Why a test cannot start now; null = it can

limit.description: USD spend limit of the shared OpenRouter key; null if it has none

used.description: USD spent so far; null if unknown

remaining.description: USD left; null if unknown or unlimited

updatedAt.description: ISO time of the reading (cached up to 60 s)

voices.description: TTS voices the model supports (empty for non-speech models)

done.description: The user has an attempt on this prompt

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT (speaking). Send the same Content-Type as audioContentType.

resetAt.description: quota_exceeded: ISO time the window resets (00:00 UTC daily, Monday 00:00 UTC weekly)

CodedError.description: Errors with a machine-readable code (docs/community.md). Map `code` to UX; `error` is a fallback.

audioContentType.description: Speaking only: audio/webm | audio/mp4 | audio/m4a | audio/wav (codec params allowed). Default audio/webm.

durationMs.description: Speaking: recording length. Writing: time spent in the editor (counts toward weekly minutes).

retryable.description: status failed: false when retrying now cannot help (AI credit/key problem); show "try later" instead of Retry

stage.description: While analyzing: the pipeline step now running. writing: feedback → scoring (feedback is ready in `partial`) → finalizing; speaking: transcribing → analyzing → finalizing. null once done|failed or before the first step.

partial.description: Writing, while stage is scoring: the feedback that is ready before the scores (errors, structure, top fixes, vocab upgrades, rewrite, text metrics: AnalysisResult fields without criteria/overall). null otherwise.

models.description: OpenRouter models that produced the analysis, by role (stt, analysis, audioPron); null until done

topFixesInDeck.description: Every top fix is already in the review deck (as POST /api/cards/bulk with source 'fix' adds them)

audioUrl.description: Examiner TTS; null when the voice failed or was skipped: show examinerText as a caption and start listening

phase.description: Phase of this line; 'done' after the closing line

prepSeconds.description: p2-prep: seconds of preparation left; POST /turn (skipped) when it ends

skipTts.description: Duplex (GPT-Live, Gemini Live) sessions speak for themselves: create the session without examiner TTS (audioUrl null)

sdp.description: The browser's SDP offer (data channel "oai-events" created before the offer)

marks.description: Question start offsets (ms) within this part

predicted.description: roundBand of the mean of the last 5 overalls per skill (ignores the skill filter)

lastFailed.description: The user's most recent submitted attempt, when its analysis failed

inDeck.description: Already added to the review deck

liveProviders.description: Live examiner providers this user may use (their own keys; the owner may use the server keys)

valid.description: false: the provider rejected this key; enter a new one

ApiKeyInfo.description: The key itself is never returned.

attemptId.description: The in-progress attempt, when there is one

answered.description: Answered questions in the in-progress attempt

assets.description: Asset key → presigned GET URL (audio supports Range)

pos.description: Practice listening: saved playback position (seconds) per part

LrStats.description: Runner pacing: seconds per part, answer changes per question, questions answered in the final 5 minutes; audio = practice playback resume state

LrAnalysis.description: Deterministic review computed at submit (null for older attempts)

audio.description: Asset key; see `assets` for the URL

timings.description: Listening word timings [word, start s, end s]; only after submission

LrTest.description: Stripped (no answers, no transcript) until submitted

trend.description: Last 30 submitted attempts per skill, oldest first

weakest.description: Up to 3 types with the lowest accuracy (at least 4 questions seen)

suggested.description: A test you have not done with the most questions of your weakest type

Current user, settings and feature access
Get settings

200.description: Effective settings (user overrides merged over defaults)

put.summary: Update settings (partial; models merge per key)

200.description: Effective settings (user overrides merged over defaults)

get.summary: OpenRouter models (cached 1 h), optionally filtered by capability
Prompt bank (30 per page) with a per-user done flag
Distinct topics and types per skill/part (for bank filters)
A random matching prompt, preferring ones the user has not done
Single prompt (figure URL presigned)
Random full speaking test: 3 P1 topics × 4 questions, a P2 cue card and its linked P3

post.summary: Create an attempt (speaking: returns a presigned audio upload URL)
post.description: Also checks the quota first (nothing is reserved yet), so a person out of tests hears before writing the essay: 429 quota_exceeded, 402 community_balance_exhausted, 503 community_busy. docs/community.md

get.summary: Attempt history, newest first, 20 per page. A guest (anonymous session) gets only their 10 latest, no paging.

post.summary: Submit an attempt for analysis (also re-runs a failed one). Returns immediately; poll GET /api/attempts/{id}.
post.description: Reserves the test against the quota (one per speaking/writing session; re-submitting the same attempt never costs again; refunded if analysis fails or no speech is heard). When refused, a writing draft sent in the body is still saved on the attempt. docs/community.md

get.summary: Lightweight status for polling (no analysis, prompt or presigned URLs); fetch the full attempt when status or stage changes
Attempt with analysis, presigned audio URL and prompt (poll until status is done|failed)

delete.summary: Delete an attempt (its analysis and mistakes cascade)

post.summary: Start a live examiner session: picks a full speaking test and returns the opening line with TTS audio
post.description: Needs the user's own key: OpenRouter for the turn-based examiner (skipTts false), OpenAI or Gemini for duplex sessions (skipTts true), else 403 live_requires_own_key. A user without an OpenRouter key also needs a test left (429 quota_exceeded, 402 community_balance_exhausted).

403.description: live_requires_own_key: the live examiner runs only on the user's own OpenRouter (turn-based), OpenAI (GPT-Live) or Gemini (Gemini Live) key

429.description: Too many requests (too_many_requests), or the test quota is used up (quota_exceeded)

post.summary: Presigned PUT for a candidate recording (a turn or a whole part) in this session
Turn-based examiner: transcribes the candidate's answer (if any) and returns the examiner's next line

403.description: live_requires_own_key: the live examiner runs only on the user's own OpenRouter (turn-based), OpenAI (GPT-Live) or Gemini (Gemini Live) key

429.description: Too many requests (too_many_requests), or the test quota is used up (quota_exceeded)

post.summary: GPT-Live over WebRTC: exchanges the browser's SDP offer for the answer. The server creates the session (model, voice and examiner instructions are ours) and attaches a sideband that records the transcript

400.description: invalid_key: OpenAI rejected the user's key

post.summary: Script control for a GPT-Live session: the server appends the instruction for this moment (session.instructions.append) through its sideband. If it could not, `content` is the instruction for the client to append on its data channel

429.description: Too many requests (too_many_requests), or the test quota is used up (quota_exceeded)
